schemes.name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
schemes.description: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year to small and marginal farmers in three equal installments of ₹2,000.
eligibility: Active bank account linked to Aadhaar
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in or visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC)

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss due to natural calamities, pests and diseases.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through bank, insurance company, or Common Service Centre before cutoff date

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
schemes.description: Provides farmers with timely credit for agricultural needs including crop cultivation, post-harvest expenses, and allied activities.
benefits: Credit limit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% interest
eligibility: All farmers — individual or joint borrowers
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply at any nationalized bank, cooperative bank, or regional rural bank

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.description: Provides farmers with soil health cards containing crop-wise nutrient recommendations to improve productivity and reduce fertilizer costs.
schemes.how_to_apply: Contact nearest Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or Agriculture Department office

schemes.name: PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
schemes.description: Aims to improve farm water use efficiency with motto 'Har Khet Ko Pani, More Crop Per Drop' through micro-irrigation and watershed development.
eligibility: Priority to small and marginal farmers
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through State Agriculture Department or visit pmksy.gov.in

schemes.name: National Agriculture Market (eNAM)
schemes.description: Online trading platform for agricultural commodities connecting farmers directly to buyers across India for better price discovery.
eligibility: All farmers with produce to sell
schemes.how_to_apply: Register at enam.gov.in or nearest participating mandi

schemes.name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
schemes.description: Promotes organic farming by providing financial assistance to farmers adopting organic practices through cluster approach.
eligibility: Farmers willing to adopt organic farming
schemes.how_to_apply: Contact State Agriculture Department or nearest KVK for cluster formation

schemes.name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
schemes.description: Provides medium to long-term debt financing for post-harvest management and community farming assets.
benefits: Long repayment period up to 7 years
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply online at agriinfra.dac.gov.in or through participating banks

schemes.name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY)
schemes.description: Provides flexibility to states to plan and execute schemes for agriculture and allied sector development.
eligibility: Varies by state and scheme component
Priority to small and marginal farmers
schemes.how_to_apply: Contact State Agriculture Department for state-specific implementation

schemes.name: PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
schemes.description: Pension scheme for small and marginal farmers providing ₹3,000 per month after age 60 through voluntary contribution.
eligibility: Not covered under other pension schemes
schemes.how_to_apply: Enroll at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with ₹2 registration fee
